summary.intent: Drive CipherBox v2 wave 4/5/6 PR lifecycle work to completion: locate/execute wave plans, resolve automated PR review findings via delegated sub-agents, manage the CodeRabbit/macroscope review-cycle machinery, rebase and merge PRs in dependency order, verify tracker (GitHub issue) hygiene, and plan subsequent waves.
summary.outcome: Waves 4 and 5 fully merged (13 PRs total) with all review findings resolved and verified against committed trees; wave 5 was driven entirely unattended overnight with no merges (per agreed boundary). Wave 6 was planned, #648 split into 4 sequenced sub-issues, multiple tracker defects and a stale STAGING_API_URL naming issue were fixed, and 8+ new issues were filed with verified dependency edges.

repo: Two PRs adding an identical field/type to one shared interface/enum merge textually CLEAN with no conflict markers and silently duplicate the declaration (TS2300/TS1117, or Rust E0004 non-exhaustive match) — this bit apps/web/src/vault/useFolderNavigation.ts (wave 4) and crates/engine/src/net/rotation.rs ResealError handling (wave 5). Always simulate with `git merge-file`/build a combined worktree before trusting `mergeable: CLEAN`.
CodeRabbit posts a 'clean' verdict only as a status-comment edit ('No actionable comments were generated'), never as a review entry — polling review bodies alone hangs forever on a clean PR.
macroscope's five check-run agents completing ('conclusion != null') does not mean findings have posted — it once posted a new inline thread 9 minutes after its check-runs finished.

macroscope's own suggested diffs are sometimes wrong or dangerous: `{other:?}` failed to compile because AdoptOutcome deliberately has no Debug impl (holds Zeroizing seed material); `other.err()` would have discarded the Ok-path verdict entirely.

CodeRabbit's suggested `clear_session` fix would have destroyed the persisted refresh credential, turning one malformed response into a session-destroying DoS — client-side in-memory-only token clear was correct instead.
GitHub REST `.parent` field on issues always returns null (false negative) — must use the GraphQL/sub-issues API to detect true parent-orphan status before judging an umbrella issue complete.

A `#[cfg(test)]`-only trait implementor compiles and passes tests but represents zero production coverage — the reliable check is 'does this primitive have any production caller at all', not 'does an impl exist'. This missed WriteSubtreeResolver and ScopeExitRotator as untracked for multiple issue-closure cycles.
`Web E2E Smoke Result` required CI check is flaky (smoke.spec.ts:43 signout redirect) and blocks unrelated (even engine-only) PRs intermittently; re-running the same commit resolves it.

Result-gate CI jobs (`if: always()`, pass unless failure/cancelled) silently pass when their guarded job is `skipped` — e.g. if `Detect Changes` fails, both `Desktop Build Result` and `Web E2E Smoke Result` report green having verified nothing.

`vars.STAGING_API_URL` DOES exist at the staging environment scope — an earlier claim that it didn't exist at any scope was a false negative caused by the GitHub environments-variables API defaulting to 10-per-page pagination (15 vars existed).
chunk_size = 1_048_536 in ContentProfile::PRODUCTION is deliberate, not a typo — it's `(1<<20) - NONCE_LEN(24) - TAG_LEN(16)` so the sealed leaf is exactly 1 MiB.

code.finding: GatedRoots::take is destructive (one slot, evicted on re-park) — underlies #1054's idempotency fix
reseal_verdict exhaustive match on ResealError required manual addition of TooManyCommittedGrants arm when #1098 and #1101 were combined — the wave-5/6 semantic merge conflict site
Login challenge signed without prefix validation — live signing oracle, fixed in #1099 by requiring exact 'cipherbox-login:v2:' + 64 lowercase hex
Command::Grant (not Command::Share, which doesn't exist) is the facade command arm for grants
Catch-all arm for unimplemented facade Command variants
rebase_update_content never reads op.base_sequence — silent lost-update on concurrent content writes, filed as #1106
publish_head passes min_current_sequence: None, so the record CAS has no precondition, allowing silent clobber
WriteSubtreeResolver has only test-fake implementors, zero production impl — untracked gap surfaced by #1014 forensics, filed as #1108

workflow: Delegate full /resolve-pr-reviews flow to a single sub-agent per PR rather than doing it inline — user's standing preference.

Never apply a reviewer's suggested diff literally — treat it as a symptom report; verify the mechanism yourself, including compiling/testing the reverted-then-restored code to prove a fix is non-vacuous.
Always verify the COMMITTED tree (git show HEAD:<path>, git status --porcelain empty before AND after gates) before pushing — working-tree-only fixes have been pushed unamended at least twice.
Give parallel/worktree agents unique scratchpad file paths — a shared scratchpad directory caused one agent's PR-body draft to be silently overwritten by a sibling's file of the same name.
Before closing/judging an umbrella tracking issue as complete, re-parent any orphaned children first — GitHub REST .parent returning null makes orphans invisible to sub-issue rollups.

Build combined multi-PR merge trees and run full gates (fmt/check/clippy/test/wasm32 + TS typecheck/lint/test) before declaring 'reviewed and green' — textually clean merges can still fail to compile.
Read exit codes directly (cmd; echo $?), never through a pipe (`cmd | tail; echo $?` reports tail's exit code, masking real failures).

friction: macroscope ran out of credits mid-wave (00:54Z), silently reported as 'completed' (skipped) by the cycle script until the detection logic was fixed — six of seven wave-5 PRs got only one bot's review.
Greptile quota-locked until mid-August, unavailable the whole session.
Flaky required Web E2E Smoke Result check blocked an unrelated engine-only PR (#1103) intermittently.
Intermittent GitHub/network outages throughout (api.github.com refused connections, git fetch timeouts) required retry logic in scripts.
zsh word-splitting bug in an unquoted loop caused an issue to be mis-parented, caught only by read-back verification.
Shared Puppeteer MCP browser got navigated away by a sibling session mid-run, forcing a fallback to scripted Playwright.
`gh api` does not accept `--arg`; jq filters must have the shell variable interpolated directly into the query string.
